This offer is other than full and open competition acquisition and will be solicited by FAR part 15.1. This is not set aside for small businesses. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available.

Award will be given to the offer(s) whose quote(s) conforms to the solicitation requirements and represents the best value to the Government. Past performance, offered delivery, and price will be evaluated when making a comparative assessment of quotes. An award may be made to other then lowest price, technically acceptable.

This procurement has been identified as containing CDI/CUI. The contractor must have a current (i.e., not more than 3 years old) NIST SP 800-171 assessment score posted in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS). All covered contractor information systems shall be covered   

The following method(s) of submitting a proposal are authorized in the solicitation:

DIBBS Upload – to submit an offer through DIBBS, search for the solicitation then click the red: offer” button on the search results screen. (Note: Users must be logged onto DIBBS in order to submit the offer though DIBBS) For additional guidance, refer to https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/refs/help/solicitations/DIBBS-Upload-Offer-User-Help.pdf
